guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation tables without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing and the browser's layout engine; wrap potentially-wide content in overflow containers; use overflow-wrap on unbreakable tokens; let flex rows wrap; avoid hardcoded widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} around every doc/compat table on both routes; overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1, lede, p/li/td code and table cells; pre blocks scroll internally; .baseline-browsers is a wrapping flex row. Exception: no container queries — the shared single-column editorial measure fits the reference format (same as prior accepted pages).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible code blocks pre scroll keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place all content within landmarks; structure with sequential headings; use semantic tables with th scope; don't fake headings; ensure keyboard reachability of scrollable regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single main landmark, h1>h2 sequential outline (child sections use h2), th scope=row on every definition row and scope-bearing headers on compat tables, role=note + aria-label on the baseline banner, descriptive iframe title. Exception: scrollable pre/table regions are not given tabindex=0 — matches the site-wide exemplar pattern; recorded as a follow-up rather than diverging from the shared design system unilaterally.

guidanceConsulted.query: embed third-party iframe lazy loading performance
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lazy-load non-critical below-the-fold embeds and deprioritize non-critical resources so they don't compete with critical content (Lazy-loading images and iframes; fetch priority).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase demo iframe uses loading="lazy" with explicit width/height (no CLS) and sits below the primary reference content.
